caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass tumbler, positioned upright in the center of the composition. The glass is rendered with meticulous detail and is colored with shades of amber and brown, giving the appearance of tinted glass. The interior and exterior surfaces of the glass reflect and refract light, with some areas showing highlights and darker shadows, particularly at the base and along the sides. The glass sits on a plain, cream-colored background. A rectangular border, drawn in pencil or a fine line, frames the central area containing the glass, leaving a wide margin of plain paper around it. In the lower right corner of the paper, outside the border, the name "R. MANUPELLI" is written in uppercase letters. There are no other objects or markings within the drawing.
title: Amber Glass
